title.zh-CN: val 与 var 的赋值语义
title.en: Assignment semantics of val and var

explanation.zh-CN: val 只禁止重新赋值，不保证对象内部不可变；var 可以重新赋值但类型固定。本例为只读示例：App 内暂不能执行 Kotlin。
explanation.en: val forbids reassignment but does not make the referenced object immutable; var can be reassigned while its type stays fixed. This is a read-only sample because Kotlin cannot run inside the app yet.

note.zh-CN: val 声明的引用不能再赋值
note.en: A val reference cannot be reassigned

note.zh-CN: visits 需要累加，因此使用 var
note.en: visits accumulates, so it uses var

title.zh-CN: val 不等于深度不可变

explanation.zh-CN: val 只锁定引用，list 内部仍可修改；需要真正只读时优先使用 listOf 返回的只读集合。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: val only locks the reference while the list contents can still change; prefer the read-only collections returned by listOf when real immutability is needed. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 引用不可变但仍可调用修改方法
note.en: The reference is fixed but mutating methods still work

note.zh-CN: 对同一个 List 实例做修改
note.en: Mutates the same List instance

explanation.zh-CN: count 推断为 Int，ratio 推断为 Double，names 推断为 List<String>；公共 API 建议显式标注返回类型。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: count is inferred as Int, ratio as Double and names as List<String>; public APIs should annotate return types explicitly. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 3 是 Int 字面量，推断为 Int
note.en: 3 is an Int literal, so the type is Int

note.zh-CN: 0.5 推断为 Double
note.en: 0.5 is inferred as Double

explanation.zh-CN: String? 类型不能直接访问 length，?. 只在非空时调用，?: 提供默认值。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: A String? cannot be dereferenced directly; ?. calls only when non-null and ?: supplies a default. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: ? 表示可空类型
note.en: The ? marks a nullable type

note.zh-CN: 左侧为 null 时取 0
note.en: Falls back to 0 when the left side is null

title.zh-CN: Elvis 操作符提供默认值

explanation.zh-CN: name 可空，display 用 ?: 在缺失时回退到 guest。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: name is nullable and display falls back to guest through ?: when it is missing. Read-only sample.

examples.code:
val name: String? = null
val display = name ?: "guest"
println(display)

note.zh-CN: Elvis 操作符
note.en: The Elvis operator

note.zh-CN: 推断出的非空 String
note.en: Inferred as a non-null String

title.zh-CN: 用密封类和 when 穷尽分支
title.en: Exhaustive when over a sealed class

explanation.zh-CN: Result 是密封类，when 覆盖 Ok 与 Err 后无需 else；新增子类时编译器会提示遗漏。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Result is sealed, so when covers Ok and Err without an else; adding a subtype makes the compiler report a missing branch. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: when 作为表达式直接返回 String
note.en: when is an expression returning String

note.zh-CN: is 分支做类型判断
note.en: The is branch checks the subtype

title.en: Higher-order function with a trailing lambda

explanation.zh-CN: repeatTwice 接受 () -> Unit 参数；调用时尾随 Lambda 写在括号外，块内可重复执行动作。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: repeatTwice takes a () -> Unit parameter; the trailing lambda sits outside the parentheses and runs the action twice. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 函数参数是函数类型
note.en: The parameter has a function type

note.zh-CN: 尾随 Lambda 写法
note.en: Trailing lambda syntax

explanation.zh-CN: data class 自动生成 toString/equals/copy；copy 只改动指定字段并返回新实例。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: A data class generates toString/equals/copy; copy changes only the named field and returns a new instance. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: data 修饰符生成数据类方法
note.en: The data modifier generates data-class methods

note.zh-CN: copy 返回新实例，原实例不变
note.en: copy returns a new instance and leaves the original unchanged

explanation.zh-CN: data class 自动提供 component1/component2，因此可以一次声明多个变量。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: A data class provides component1/component2, so several variables can be declared at once. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 解构声明同时声明两个变量
note.en: Destructuring declares two variables at once

note.zh-CN: Point 提供 componentN
note.en: Point provides componentN

explanation.zh-CN: 调用方只依赖 Logger 接口，替换实现不需要修改调用代码。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: The caller depends only on the Logger interface, so swapping implementations needs no caller changes. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 接口只声明契约
note.en: The interface only declares the contract

note.zh-CN: override 必须显式写出
note.en: override must be written explicitly

explanation.zh-CN: 为 String 添加 isEmail()，调用处读起来像成员函数，但它是按静态类型解析的扩展。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: isEmail() is added to String and reads like a member, but it is an extension resolved by static type. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 扩展函数名
note.en: Name of the extension function

note.zh-CN: 在 Lambda 中调用扩展函数
note.en: Calling the extension inside a lambda

explanation.zh-CN: mapNotNull 解析并丢弃非法值，filter 保留大额，fold 求和；全程没有可变累加器。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: mapNotNull parses and drops invalid values, filter keeps large items and fold sums them, with no mutable accumulator. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 解析失败的元素变成 null 并被丢弃
note.en: Elements that fail to parse become null and are dropped

note.zh-CN: fold 从 0 开始累加
note.en: fold accumulates from 0

explanation.zh-CN: generateSequence 惰性生成，take(4) 后只计算前四项再 toList；与集合版本相比不产生多余中间数据。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: generateSequence produces values lazily, take(4) limits computation to four items before toList, and no redundant intermediate data is built. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 从 1 开始按规则惰性生成
note.en: Generates lazily from 1 using the rule

note.zh-CN: 只取前四项，避免无限生成
note.en: Takes only four items, avoiding infinite generation

title.en: A suspend function suspends while waiting

explanation.zh-CN: loadName 用 delay 挂起 100ms，期间线程可以执行其他任务；调用必须在协程作用域内。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: loadName suspends for 100ms through delay while the thread stays free; calls must happen inside a coroutine scope. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: suspend 标记可挂起函数
note.en: suspend marks the function as suspending

note.zh-CN: runBlocking 只用于入口演示
note.en: runBlocking is only for the entry-point demo

explanation.zh-CN: coroutineScope 内的两个 async 并发执行，函数返回前会等待它们；任一子协程失败会取消同级任务。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: Two async tasks run concurrently inside coroutineScope and the function waits for both; any child failure cancels its siblings. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 作用域等待所有子协程
note.en: The scope waits for all children

note.zh-CN: async 返回可 await 的 Deferred
note.en: async returns an awaitable Deferred

title.zh-CN: 在 Java 边界显式处理平台类型
title.en: Handling platform types at a Java boundary

explanation.zh-CN: 下面用 Kotlin 函数模拟 Java 方法返回的平台类型；进入 Kotlin 后应立即写成可空类型并用 Elvis 兜底，而不是依赖 !!。本例为只读示例。
explanation.en: A Kotlin function simulates a Java method returning a platform type; on the Kotlin side declare it nullable and use an Elvis fallback instead of relying on !!. Read-only sample.

note.zh-CN: 显式声明可空类型
note.en: Explicit nullable type

note.zh-CN: 用 Elvis 兜底而不是 !!
note.en: Elvis fallback instead of !!
